This is a phone-first, proactive role, not a back-office tracking seat. The LP1's core job is speed and appointments: reach every new lead fast, walk them through the intake questionnaire by phone, and get qualified consultations onto the calendar.

It requires extraordinary communication skills, strong time and priority management, high attention to detail, and superb organization. Schedule and confirm initial loan consultations on the calendar.
Set 20 appointments per week for the Loan Officer.
Confirm 100% of appointments 24 hours in advance so no one is left guessing; handle and re-book no-shows.

Manage the inbox daily using the Delete, Defer, Do, Delegate framework.

Own and maintain the calendar, schedule, protect, and de-conflict time.
Maintain an organized inbox at all times and manage all incoming correspondence.
Communication standard: respond to internal messages the same business day and to borrower/partner messages within 24 hours. Maintain lead tracking in the CRM, ensure all contact information (name, phone, email) is current and accurate.
Keep the lead & appointment pipeline and tracking documents up to date.
Track every lead from first contact through appointment scheduled, no lead falls through the cracks.
Ensure all systems are aligned and the team always knows the current status of every lead and active file.

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA , we're looking for the same kind of person.
Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.
We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

About the Hiring Manager
Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Customer Experience at Wonderly .
I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.
I'm hiring early-career operators who can sell. People I can put on the phone with a business owner and trust to open the relationship, run the conversation, and move the deal forward. The role I'm hiring for is the role I would have killed for at 22.

You own the top of our funnel. You'll run outbound to service business owners — cold calls, follow-ups, whatever it takes to get them on the phone — pitch the Wonderly model, qualify for fit, and hand the hot ones off (often live) to our team to close.
You're the first human a future customer talks to. The pipeline grows because you make it grow.
This is not a read-from-a-script seat. Our outbound motion is early, and you'll help build the playbook, not inherit a finished one. When something in the process is broken, you flag it and help fix it.
The work is hands-on and high-volume. You'll live on the phone, own your number, keep your pipeline and CRM tight, and feed what you're hearing back into how we target and message. You're not above the grind, and you're not just a dialer either — you think about how to make the whole motion better.
And it's not only calls. We have aggressive growth goals, and hitting them means the outbound engine has to scale — which means digging into your own data, spotting what's working and what isn't, and helping build the systems and process that let us do 10x the volume without falling apart.

You'll analyze your numbers, surface patterns, and help stand up the tooling and playbook that scale us. The best people here don't just hit their number, they help build the machine that makes everyone's number easier to hit.
If you want a defined script and a narrow lane, this isn't it. If you want to carry a number, build the outbound engine with us, and get dramatically better at selling fast, apply.
What Makes This Role Different
Most early-career sales roles are narrow. You join, you run someone else's script, you get good at one motion.
This is the opposite. You're getting in early on the outbound engine of a company that's scaling fast — which means outsized ownership, real influence on the playbook, and a front-row seat to how a company goes from early traction to serious scale. Top performers here move fast into senior sales, team lead, and ops roles.

Deine Rolle
Als Aussendienstmitarbeiter/in bei der Volmera GmbH bist du täglich in deiner Verkaufsregion unterwegs und vertrittst moderne Energielösungen direkt beim Kunden.
Du begleitest den gesamten Verkaufsprozess – vom ersten persönlichen Kontakt über die Beratung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei arbeitest du selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse und wirst gleichzeitig durch klare Prozesse, regelmässige Schulungen und ein engagiertes Team unterstützt.
Bei uns zählt nicht nur Verkaufserfahrung. Entscheidend sind deine Einstellung, deine Lernbereitschaft, dein Auftreten und dein Wille, dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Deine Aufgaben

* Aktive Neukundenakquise im Aussendienst
* Persönliche Ansprache von Hauseigentümerinnen und Hauseigentümern
* Vereinbarung von qualifizierten Beratungsterminen
* Durchführung persönlicher Verkaufsgespräche beim Kunden
* Analyse der individuellen Kundensituation und des Energiebedarfs
* Beratung rund um moderne Solar- und Energielösungen
* Verständliche Präsentation unserer Produkte und deren Vorteile
* Erstellung einer passenden Lösung für den jeweiligen Kunden
* Aktive Führung des Verkaufsgesprächs bis zum Vertragsabschluss
* Professioneller Umgang mit Fragen und Einwänden
* Betreuung der Kunden vom Erstkontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
* Saubere Dokumentation und Pflege der Kundenkontakte
* Teilnahme an internen Schulungen, Verkaufstrainings und Teamsitzungen
* Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der eigenen Verkaufs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
Was wir von dir erwarten
Du musst bei uns kein fertiger Verkaufsprofi sein. Wir suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, Verantwortung für ihre eigene Entwicklung und ihre Leistung zu übernehmen.

* Freude am persönlichen Kontakt mit Menschen
* Selbstbewusstes und gepflegtes Auftreten
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
* Kommunikationsstärke und Überzeugungskraft
* Eigeninitiative und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
* Disziplin, Zuverlässigkeit und Durchhaltevermögen
* Bereitschaft, Feedback anzunehmen und umzusetzen
* Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an persönlicher Weiterentwicklung
* Leistungs- und Zielorientierung
* Bereitschaft, aktiv auf neue Menschen zuzugehen
* Führerausweis Kategorie B
* Eigenes Fahrzeug
Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger sind ausdrücklich willkommen.
Erfahrung im Verkauf oder Aussendienst ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Viel wichtiger ist für uns, dass du bereit bist, zu lernen und Leistung zu bringen.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Bei der Volmera GmbH erhältst du nicht einfach einen Arbeitsplatz. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, dir im Verkauf etwas aufzubauen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Unser Arbeitsalltag
Unser Aussendienst lebt von persönlichem Kundenkontakt. Deshalb verbringen unsere Mitarbeitenden einen grossen Teil ihrer Arbeitszeit direkt in ihrer Verkaufsregion.
Der Arbeitsalltag besteht aus der aktiven Kundengewinnung, der Terminierung sowie den anschliessenden Beratungsgesprächen beim Kunden.
Zusätzlich finden regelmässige interne Schulungen und Verkaufstrainings statt. Dadurch sollst du nicht nur unsere Produkte kennen, sondern lernen, Kundensituationen richtig einzuschätzen, Gespräche professionell zu führen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Wen wir suchen
Wir suchen keine Person, die einfach nur irgendeinen Job möchte.
Wir suchen Menschen, die etwas erreichen wollen.
Menschen, die bereit sind, auf andere zuzugehen, Neues zu lernen, an sich zu arbeiten und auch dann dranzubleiben, wenn nicht jeder Tag gleich erfolgreich läuft.
Du solltest Freude daran haben, deine eigenen Ergebnisse aktiv beeinflussen zu können. Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, konsequent an sich arbeitet und Leistung zeigt, soll bei uns auch die Möglichkeit erhalten, entsprechend weiterzukommen.
Über uns
Die Volmera GmbH ist als Franchisepartner von EET-Schweiz im Bereich moderner Energielösungen tätig.
Unser Fokus liegt auf der persönlichen Beratung von Hauseigentümerinnen und Hauseigentümern und auf Lösungen, mit denen erneuerbare Energie einfach und sinnvoll in den Alltag integriert werden kann.

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.
This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.
What will you be doing? 😎
Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.
Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.
Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.
Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.
Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.
Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.
What do we need from you? 💪
1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.
A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.
Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.
Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.
Native or professional proficiency in English is required for this role.
Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.

1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.
A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.
Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.
Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.
Native or professional proficiency in English.
Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Du gewinnst neue Zahnarztpraxen für Doctolib und begleitest sie auf dem Weg zu einer effizienteren, digitaleren Organisation. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.
Deine Aufgaben
Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.

Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.

Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du hast bereits eigenständig Pipeline aufgebaut und neue Kund:innen gewonnen

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

Life at Mews
We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.
We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

s.h: A few things that define how we work
s.t:
High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.
If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.
We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

Help make the world more hospitable
The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the West Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.
You will work across the West Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the West Coast.
What you would do
Run multi-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
Research and tier new business opportunities in the West Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting
What you would bring
Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high-contact customer-facing position
Hospitality experience strongly encouraged
A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision-maker profiles
AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result
AI Fluency Level 2: In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
Deep hospitality knowledge
Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, SFE, CRM, etc..) to support patient education regarding nutrition and Abbott brands, to influence customer and patient choice of nutrition products, and deliver a consistent, end-to-end customer engagement experience.

About Airwallex
Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
Attributes We Value
We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

As a Founding SDR (Germany) , you will serve as the growth engine for Airwallex’s expansion in the DACH region. This is a zero-to-one builder role: you will not just execute outbound sequences, you will design the playbooks, test AI-assisted outreach tools, define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and establish the foundation for our German pipeline.
Operating with an entrepreneurial mindset, you will bridge the gap between marketing initiatives and closed deals, driving high-value opportunities into the funnel. For top performers, this role offers a clear trajectory into a Closing Business Development Manager (BDM)/Account Executive role.

Build and Scale German Outbound: Design, iterate, and execute a modern, AI-assisted outbound strategy (sequencing, enrichment, lead scoring) tailored specifically to the German market.
Generate and Qualify Pipeline: Identify high-value accounts, initiate contact via multi-channel plays (cold calls, personalized email, social selling), and qualify interest to generate high-volume, high-quality sales pipeline.
Create Playbooks and Assets: Develop and test target prospect plays across the buyer journey, creating the scalable tools, messaging frameworks, and assets needed for market expansion.
Product-Led Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing and Product teams to launch bespoke, localized campaigns and turn market feedback into actionable insights.
Seamless Sales Hand-Offs: Move qualified prospects smoothly through the early funnel, uncovering deep business needs before briefing sales leadership for closed-loop hand-offs.
CRM and Data Hygiene: Maintain meticulous CRM records, monitor activity SLAs, and analyze outbound performance metrics to continuously optimize response and conversion rates.
What You’ll Need
Proven SDR Track Record: 1+ years of experience in a high-performing B2B SaaS or Fintech SDR/BDR role with a history of exceeding targets.
Zero-to-One Mindset: Demonstrated experience setting up or refining outbound strategies (ICP definitions, playbooks, toolstacks) in a new or early-stage market.
Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in German (verbal and written) and professional working fluency in English .
AI and Modern Sales Tech Stack: Hands-on experience leveraging modern outbound AI tools (such as automated enrichment, AI co-pilots, intent data, hyper-personalized messaging).
Bias for Action: Thrives in ambiguity, acts with high urgency, and brings a hyper-growth, team-first attitude.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
Location: London, UK

Faire’s quality, depth, and breadth of supply is one of our strongest value propositions to retailers, and our Enterprise Brand Partnerships team plays a critical role in bringing the best and most relevant brands onto our platform.
As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll directly contribute to Faire’s growth by identifying and engaging prospective French-speaking brands, building thoughtful outbound strategies, and generating qualified partnership opportunities for our Enterprise Account Executive team. Depending on your experience, you may be developing these foundational skills or independently managing more complex prospecting motions and contributing to broader team initiatives.
We’re looking for a commercially curious, highly motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds strong relationships, and enjoys solving problems creatively. We’re open to candidates with different levels of experience and will determine leveling based on demonstrated skills throughout the interview process.
Faire’s goal is to become the default platform for brands to grow their wholesale businesses and for independent retailers to discover products for their stores. As we continue to scale, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to take ownership, deepen your sales expertise, and grow your career at Faire.

Sur le marché suisse des PME, tu ouvres les bonnes portes, identifies les potentiels et mets notre initiative RH-pour-PME en avant de manière ciblée. **Ce que tu accomplis**

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist.
What you'll actually do
You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right.
What this role could turn into
We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there.
We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are.
Who thrives here
You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point.
We hire for range
We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
Location and working policy
📍 Sydney, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.
Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team.

You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal ’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal ’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200+ specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody.

We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. -Rethink Everything- is our philosophy - it is at the heart of everything we do.

We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.As Chief of Staff to the Head of IT Infrastructure, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the management, governance and transformation of a critical technology function.

You will act as a trusted partner to the Head of IT Infrastructure, driving strategic execution, facilitating decision-making, coordinating key initiatives and ensuring alignment across IT Infrastructure, IT Security, IT Operations, Corporate Services and senior stakeholders.

This role combines strategic thinking, operational excellence and strong stakeholder management in a highly visible environment. YOUR ROLE Support the Head of IT Infrastructure in managing departmental priorities, governance, and strategic objectives.

Ensure effective governance of the department, including leadership meetings, steering committees and executive reporting. Coordinate and drive strategic initiatives and transformation programs across the Infrastructure organization. Provide leadership with clear visibility on priorities, risks, dependencies, budgets and delivery progress.

Facilitate collaboration between Infrastructure, Security, Operations and business stakeholders. Identify and remove organizational and operational bottlenecks impacting execution. Drive continuous improvement of portfolio management, reporting, governance and decision-making processes.

Support communication, change management and organizational development initiatives. Prepare executive presentations, management updates and decision materials for senior leadership. YOUR PROFILE Proven ability to influence and lead without formal authority. Strong organizational, planning and coordination skills.

Strategic mindset with a pragmatic and hands-on approach. Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into concise executive-level messages. Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate across organizational boundaries.

Good understanding of IT Infrastructure, IT governance, project portfolio management, risk management and technology transformation. Experience in a complex and highly regulated environment is an advantage. Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate. Our Maison-s DNA is defined by five core values.
